name: Drum kit
summary: Drum kit with bass drum, two toms, snare, hi-hat and crash cymbal on stands; anim play hits each piece in turn.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the bass drum feet rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; room-sized: about 940 px wide and 660 px tall at s = 0.85 (the whole kit fits within the frame at this scale)

params.name: anim
params.note: play = each drum and cymbal is struck in turn and bounces

author: krakujs
